# Campus Lost and Found Project Instructions

- [x] HTML, CSS, and JavaScript implementation
- [x] Responsive desktop and mobile interface
- [x] Lost/found item posting workflow
- [x] Listing search and filtering by category, status, and date
- [x] Required-field and email form validation
- [x] Ownership claim form and claim activity view
- [x] localStorage persistence for listings and claims
- [x] Sample listings and sample ownership claim
- [x] Photo URL and device-image upload support
- [x] Project README and run instructions

## Project Notes

- Use vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript only.
- Keep listings in `campusFind.items` and claims in `campusFind.claims`.
- Preserve responsive behavior and the existing design system.
- Do not remove the lost/found status distinction or ownership claim workflow.
- Browser localStorage is the demonstration backend; do not introduce a database unless explicitly requested.
- Uploaded images must remain limited to 2 MB for localStorage safety.
